chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Teaching introductions to Woode and Mingus
summary: Jackson taught Jimmy Woode and Charles Mingus the Ellington introductions and Mingus never forgot it.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: And I taught him a few things that I knew. I taught him a lot of introductions and things, just like I did to other bass players that came in, like 'Satin Doll' all them introductions and things like that they didn't know and I used to teach them. I used to show them.
Mingus played with the band for a little while and I showed him too. Mingus never forgot me, you know. Right to this day he would say I was the only one that showed him anything, you know.
